basic_info.description: Marina-style home on a prime Outer Sunset block. Charm radiates throughout with its hardwood floors and myriad of period details. The living room floods with natural light and features an ornate fireplace. An elegant formal dining room complements the main level nicely. Both spacious bedrooms look out to the deep & inviting backyard. The kitchen is nice and bright. Downstairs offers abundant space for parking, storage, and further expansion possibilities. Don't miss your chance to have a lovely home in a quintessential Outer Sunset location. 1523 46th Avenue is ideally situated just a hop and a skip away from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, and all the conveniences of Judah. Don't miss this one!
